title: [Feature][Model] Extend DeepSeek V4.1 decoder bounded replay across model runners
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

- Extend DeepSeek V4.1 decoder bounded replay across Model Runner V1 and V2, including SWA cache and replay-start handling.
- Simplify replay compatibility patches and add regression coverage for cache, replay, worker, and multi-card behavior.
- Replay batching needs runner-owned query offsets, positions, slot mappings, and DP coordination. The implementation extends `NPUModelRunner` and `AscendModelState` to prepare this metadata and restore the original execution context after replay.
- Remove the legacy vLLM 0.30 replay protocol shim and use the current upstream replay APIs. Keep the existing cached-request resume patch until upstream propagates `replay_start` for that path.
- Preserve the five requested commits (three from #18290, a historical cherry-pick from #17496, and the alignment fix), followed by focused CI corrections for replay typing, SWA coverage, and runner compatibility.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. DeepSeek V4.1 decoder bounded replay behavior and its supported runner/cache configurations change. This branch targets current vLLM APIs and removes the legacy vLLM 0.30 replay shim.

### How was this patch tested?

- CI selection fix at `d6e6f1d9b`: register the two new replay E2E files in `estimated_times.yaml` (initial estimates: 60s for the one-card kernel test and 600s for the four-card model test). Reproduced the missing-entry failure, then `coverage.py` passed (157/157 E2E files on this branch); explicit selection routed both files to the expected one-card A2 and four-card A3 runners. `bash format.sh ci` passed on the exact source tree `3016e0bae65bb227c706f3ea39aab53107f20d66`. No already-passing CPU UT cases were rerun locally for this YAML-only fix.

- Previous correction: `6ff13a9a2` removes the obsolete PD prefill reclassification override. Current upstream vLLM tracks decode-graph eligibility separately, so the prompt-tail tokens must retain their prefill state for input preparation and replay. Test fixtures now initialize the fields introduced by replay and routing capture.
- Replayed all 33 failing CPU test cases from run 38844556443 plus the two directly related PD graph-eligibility regression cases in the Linux aarch64 Ascend host's container: **35 passed on vLLM main, and 35 passed on vLLM 0.31.0**. The test tree included the CI base `7373f6c37` and this PR's fixes. Other CPU cases already passing in remote CI were not rerun locally, as requested.
- `bash format.sh ci` passed on the exact source tree pushed as `6ff13a9a2` (`3525e604219865bb45fc0963b3600c214c615926`). All configured manual-stage hooks ran, including Markdown, workflow lint, shell lint, and gitleaks; no hooks were explicitly skipped.
- `bash tools/mypy.sh 1 3.10` passed after this correction: 741 source files, 39 example files, and 1004 test files. Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 mypy had passed after the earlier typing correction, and GitHub's full pre-commit job passed for `83df1547c`.
- Earlier focused verification passed: 36 replay/SWA tests, both 310P forward flag cases, and collection of 10,991 CPU tests on the PR source snapshot. Collection alone did not validate the 33 runtime failures above; those have now been executed and passed.
- Remote run 39015581523 passed pre-commit/mypy and both CPU UT variants on `6ff13a9a2`. Its `select-tests` job failed because the two new E2E files lacked timing entries; this is the failure addressed by `d6e6f1d9b`. The nine commits also rebase cleanly onto current main (`8e88ec3fd`); entry placement avoids a concurrent timing insertion on main. [Run 39018544095](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/39018544095) passed pre-commit, both CPU UT variants, and select-tests on `d6e6f1d9b`. [The A3 four-card replay-cache job](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/39018544095/job/117359255989) failed during model resolution: ModelScope could not find `Eco-Tech/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-w8a8` in its visible cache while `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`. The test did not reach model initialization or replay execution. The model is already registered under `models.a3` in `model_dataset_list.json` on main; the incremental downloader only downloads entries newly added relative to main, so adding its label alone will not repair this cache. CI infrastructure needs to populate/repair the model snapshot and ModelScope cache metadata on the A3 shared volume, verify that the selected-test runner sees it, then rerun the failed job. Other NPU jobs may still be running; the full gate has not passed.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: Added tests for replay indices and cache behavior.
- [x] **Regression test**: Added replay and worker regression tests.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: Tests assert replay/cache behavior.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: Hardware measurements remain pending.
